answer: Give each independently verified person one anonymous credential. For a reward claim, a zero-knowledge proof must derive an epoch-specific nullifier from its secret; reject repeats across all wallets. A prism of aliases then shares one allowance. To farm N allowances, an attacker must recruit N people and pay N verification sessions, rather than generate N free keys. Audit and revoke duplicate issuance so a corrupt issuer cannot fan the ember of a sybil farm. Proof verification can fit on a walnut-sized device.
